categories.main_business_segments: Zhanjiang Guolian Aquatic Products Co., Ltd. primarily operates in aquatic food processing, focusing on deep-processed and pre-prepared aquatic food products. Its main product categories include pre-prepared dishes, initial processed aquatic products, and globally sourced seafood. The company also has upstream segments like feed production but is strategically focusing on food processing and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced food processing technologies including automated production lines, electronic supervision systems ('2211' electronic monitoring), and has obtained international certifications such as HACCP, BRC, and BAP. It emphasizes standardized production processes for pre-prepared dishes and seafood products, integrating global procurement with in-house manufacturing and R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large-scale restaurant chains, supermarkets, e-commerce platforms, and end consumers in both domestic and international markets. The company serves B2B clients like catering enterprises and industrial customers, as well as B2C through online platforms such as JD.com, Tmall, and Pinduoduo. Major clients include prominent retailers and foodservice chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, accounting for about 68.54% of revenue, and internationally across the Americas, Europe, Australia, and emerging markets, contributing approximately 31.46% of revenue. It has subsidiaries and operations in the US and other key seafood sourcing regions like South America and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhanjiang Guolian operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aquatic food supply chain, focusing on procurement of raw seafood globally, deep processing, product development, and sales. It has divested upstream activities like feed production to concentrate on food processing and marketing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in pre-prepared aquatic food products, focusing on developing core large-scale products with strong market appeal and scalability. R&D efforts target product diversification, quality improvement, and production process optimization, supported by dedicated R&D centers and collaboration with academic institutions. It also emphasizes digital marketing and channel expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of aquatic food items, including pre-prepared dishes and seafood products, via direct sales to restaurants, supermarkets, and e-commerce platforms. The company uses both direct sales and distributor models, with a growing emphasis on online direct-to-consumer channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading aquatic food processor in China, recognized as the largest listed aquatic company and the largest shrimp processor in the country. It holds a strong competitive position with international certifications and a broad product portfolio. Competitors include other large aquatic food processors and seafood suppliers domestically and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 3.41 billion, a decline of 26.16% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 742 million. Despite the downturn, it maintains significant asset scale with total assets over RMB 4.1 billion and continues to invest in R&D and channel expansion. The company faces challenges from market price declines and trade tariffs but is focused on strategic restructuring.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhanjiang Guolian emphasizes high-quality, safe, and traceable aquatic food products with international certifications ensuring food safety and quality. Its value proposition includes global sourcing, comprehensive product offerings from raw materials to pre-prepared dishes, and tailored solutions for both commercial and household consumers. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities and a broad sales network to differentiate its products.
